Ranks Montgomery census tracts by the raw increase in code violation counts from 2024 to 2025 using conditional aggregation on observations, left-joining all tracts so zero-count tracts are retained.
sql:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT geoid,
         SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS violations_2024,
         SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS violations_2025
  FROM fw_pg.tract_observations
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_60c812'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND geoid IS NOT NULL
    AND (year = 2024 OR year = 2025)
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT t.name,
       (COALESCE(y.violations_2025, 0) - COALESCE(y.violations_2024, 0)) AS increase,
       COALESCE(y.violations_2024, 0) AS violations_2024,
       COALESCE(y.violations_2025, 0) AS violations_2025,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN yearly y ON t.geoid = y.geoid
ORDER BY increase DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
